name: iotsecuretunneling
description: IoT Secure Tunneling IoT Secure Tunneling creates remote connections to devices deployed in the field.

subcommands.name: close-tunnel
subcommands.description: Closes a tunnel identified by the unique tunnel id.

subcommands.name: describe-tunnel
subcommands.description: Gets information about a tunnel identified by the unique tunnel id.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: list-tunnels
subcommands.description: List all tunnels for an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: open-tunnel
subcommands.description: Creates a new tunnel, and returns two client access tokens for clients to use to connect to the IoT Secure Tunneling proxy server.

subcommands.name: rotate-tunnel-access-token
subcommands.description: Revokes the current client access token (CAT) and returns new CAT for clients to use when reconnecting to secure tunneling to access the same tunnel.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag from a resource.
